# DuneSQL queries for `Fixture-Nest` on mainnet

Generated by `nuthatch emit dune` (RFC-0055). Each table's file is one DuneSQL `SELECT` over `dune.fixture_ns.<table>`, which must hold the nest's rows with every column `varchar` except `block_number`, `log_index`, `_seq` and `block_timestamp`. Each view's file reads those same tables and projects the `_dec` and `_overflow` companions as the nest does, so it answers over the uploaded rows what the nest's view answers over its own, except the unsealed tip, which is never uploaded. Regenerate rather than edit.

## Not emitted

| name | reason |
| --- | --- |
| `total_supply` | a call table; RFC-0055 §3.3 names only event tables |
| `views/20-swaps.sql` view `swap_count` | leaves select item 1 without an alias, and DuckDB and DuneSQL name an unaliased expression differently |
| `views/30-supply.sql` statement 2 | not a `CREATE VIEW`, so it defines nothing to translate |
| `views/30-supply.sql` view `supply_reads` | reads `total_supply`, a call table; RFC-0055 §3.3 names only event tables |
